targets.authors: Piff, P. K., Kraus, M. W., Côté, S., Cheng, B. H., & Keltner, D.
targets.title: Having less, giving more: the influence of social class on prosocial behavior.
targets.evidence_quote:
Against this background, we conducted two high-powered, preregistered direct

replications of studies reported in the original contribution by Piff and colleagues (2010).
targets.outcome_quote:
In two high-powered and preregistered replication studies, we did not find evidence in

support of the relationship between social class and prosocial behavior reported by Piff et al.

(2010).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall verdict explicitly reports no support in the two preregistered studies. The same original paper also supplies the targets for four earlier conceptual replications reported here (charity measures from Study 2 and trust from Study 3), all unsuccessful; these do not add separate original papers.

reasoning: Two completed preregistered replications plus earlier conceptual attempts re-test the one Piff et al. (2010) paper. Title, four authors and DOI match the repository journal pre-proof. The original citation has no printed DOI. Numbered main replication studies are 1 and 2; four preliminary attempts are separately labelled 1–4 in Table 2.
